The sequence is defined by the following recurrence relation:

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases} 
a(n-1) + a(n-2), & \text{if } a(n-1) + a(n-2) \leq 8 \\
1, & \text{otherwise}
\end{cases}
$$

with initial conditions:

$$
a(0) = 0, \quad a(1) = 1
$$

- The sequence follows the Fibonacci recurrence $ a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-2) $ as long as the sum does not exceed 8.
- When the sum $ a(n-1) + a(n-2) $ exceeds 8, the value resets to 1.
- This reset triggers a new cycle of the Fibonacci-like pattern starting from 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, and then again resets when the sum exceeds 8.
